list.title: Roadmaps
list.subtitle: AI-planned improvement roadmaps across your repositories
list.empty: No roadmaps yet — pick some repositories and let the AI plan the way forward.

new.subtitle: Pick the repositories to plan over; the goal is optional — without one, the AI plans from the portfolio's weaknesses and risks.
new.goal_help: Plain language. e.g. "Get both services production-ready and on Python 3.13."
new.goal_placeholder: Where should these repositories end up?

view.read_only_banner: Viewing version {{number}} — a superseded plan is read-only.

drift.checking: Drift check running — the agent is comparing the plan against the code…
drift.title: Drift detected — {{count}} proposal(s) to review
drift.started: Drift check started — {{count}} repository job(s) enqueued.

generation.running_body: The engine is assessing the repositories and drafting milestones. This page updates on its own.
generation.failed_body: The generation job did not produce a plan.

item.carried_hint: Carried over from the previous version
item.execute_confirm: This dispatches an agent that implements the item in an isolated worktree. Provider-backed repositories get a branch pushed and a pull request opened; local repositories keep the branch for review inside Shire.
item.blocked_explainer: Blocked — finish, drop, or unlink the items under "Blocked by" first.
item.executing: Implementing… the agent is working on a branch.
item.execute_status_hint: This item is done — reopen it (To do) to implement it again.
item.local_review_hint: This repository is local, so no pull request was opened. Review the branch against your default branch as a Shire merge review.

regenerate.title: Regenerate this roadmap?
regenerate.body: The AI re-plans from the current state of the repositories and creates version N+1. Done items (and in-progress items with an open PR) carry over; everything else is re-planned on merit.

insights.burnup_empty: Not enough history yet — progress accrues as items move.
insights.radar_subtitle: The AI's per-repo assessment from this version's generation (1–10 per dimension).

export.failed: Export failed — is a plan generated yet?

repo_tab.empty: No roadmap covers this repository yet.
repo_tab.no_items: This roadmap has no items for this repository in its current version.

graph.legend_order: Left to right = dependency order: start with the leftmost open tickets.
